summary: Probabilities come from the measured share of similar past bars (same 24h trend and RSI bucket) that were higher 24 trading hours later. Crypto, gold and EURUSD show below-average up shares; USD pairs against JPY, CHF and CAD show above-average shares. Values are shrunk towards 0.50 and never exceed the measured share. DAX is left out because its share is 50%.
